overview: Set in Brazil, three kids who make a discovery in a garbage dump soon find themselves running from the cops and trying to right a terrible wrong.
tagline: You never know what you might find

recs.blurb: In Victorian England, a master criminal makes elaborate plans to steal a shipment of gold from a moving train.
Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.
Four young men make a risky investment together that puts them in trouble with the mob.
An Argentinian crime drama revolving around a sheet of rare stamps (the Nine Queens).
Two misunderstood suburban kids challenge society and run from the police while documenting all of their deeds with a digital camera.
A Tennessee-set drama focused on an individual's spiritual redemption.
A corrupt cop gets in over his head when he tries to assassinate a beautiful Russian hit-woman.
A fearless cop is taking on a ruthless crimelord. He knew the risks. He just didn't know how far he would have to go.
In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.
A woman framed for her husband's murder suspects he is still alive; as she has already been tried for the crime, she can't be re-prosecuted if she finds and…
Multiple storylined drama set in 1932, showing the lives of upstairs guest and downstairs servants at a party in a country house in England.
A three-tiered story centered around drugs and organized crime, and focused on a young man who becomes a runner for a coke dealer.
